title: Transforming Integer Grids to Spatial Intuition: Perception, Not Planning, Governs ARC-AGI-3
abstract: arXiv:2611.06793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sample-efficient fluid intelligence requires agents that rapidly form working models of unfamiliar interactive environments. ARC-AGI-3 tests this across uninstructed visual games scored by Relative Human Action Efficiency, which penalizes exploratory waste quadratically. When frontier models read raw integer grids, serialization destroys spatial topology, and they spend hundreds of actions rediscovering basic boundaries and symmetries. We introduce SARBLOH, an open-weight agent built on the premise that spatial perception, not planning capacity, governs interactive reasoning on ARC-AGI-3. A zero-parameter O(HW) perception engine turns each frame, in 35 ms, into an object inventory with bipartite temporal tracking, a geometric briefing that separates proven invariants from affordance hypotheses, and an annotated canvas. Paired with a code-as-action runtime, the agent writes algorithmic hypotheses instead of low-level moves. Across eight

translated_title: 将整数网格转化为空间直觉：主导ARC-AGI-3的是感知而非规划
translated_abstract: 样本高效的流体智能需要能够快速建立陌生交互环境工作模型的智能体。ARC-AGI-3通过无指令视觉游戏对此进行测试，游戏采用“相对人类动作效率”评分，该评分会以二次方方式惩罚探索性浪费。当前沿模型读取原始整数网格时，序列化破坏了空间拓扑结构，导致它们需要花费数百个动作来重新发现基本的边界和对称性。我们提出了SARBLOH，一个开源权重的智能体，其建立在一个前提之上：ARC-AGI-3上的交互推理由空间感知而非规划能力所主导。一个零参数、复杂度为O(HW)的感知引擎能在35毫秒内将每一帧转化为包含二部图时间跟踪的对象清单、区分已验证不变量与可供性假设的几何简报，以及一个带注释的画布。配合“代码即动作”的运行时机制，该智能体编写的是算法级假设而非低级动作。在八个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出开源智能体SARBLOH，证明在ARC-AGI-3交互推理中起决定作用的是空间感知而非规划能力——其零参数O(HW)感知引擎可在35毫秒内将整数网格帧转化为对象清单与几何简报，从而大幅减少前沿模型因序列化破坏空间拓扑而产生的高昂探索浪费。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SARBLOH, an open-weight agent showing that spatial perception, not planning capacity, governs interactive reasoning on ARC-AGI-3, using a zero-parameter O(HW) perception engine that converts grid frames into object inventories and geometric briefings in 35 ms, drastically reducing the exploratory waste frontier models incur from serialization destroying spatial topology.
